subject: Appointment swap request
text: I can move the appointment. Thursday is better. Please set it to nine. I need ten minutes early. My car is at the shop. I will take the bus. It stops near the corner. If that fails, ten works. Please text me. Also, hold my clipboard. I left it on the bench. That tiny favor helps. I will bring coffee next time. Thanks for adjusting this. I appreciate your patience. That small change helps.
